label: s2_side01_0120_friend_02
text: Ah...yeah... Sorry about hanging up on you like\nthat. Probably gave you the wrong impression.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0120_friend_03
text: It was all Penny’s fault.\c\nShe went into full panic mode and ran smack into\nme. With her head. So I dropped my phone.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0120_botan_01
text: Can you blame me?! Look at the people in this\ntown! Something’s seriously wrong with them!\r\nNever mind whatever that weird THING was![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0120_botan_02
text: It was, like, round and little...and WEIRD![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0120_friend_05
text: And just where is this little hallucination of yours?\nYou sure you weren’t just seeing stuff?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0120_botan_03
text: It was real!!! I really I saw it![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0120_brother_03
text: I think I might have figured out why everyone is\nacting so strange.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0120_brother_04
text: Until we know for sure, though, maybe we should\nall be careful around any weird mo—[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
